title: Reward Design for Physical Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.13993v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Physical reasoning over images requires integrating perception, domain knowledge, and multi-step symbolic inference, yet Vision-Language Models (VLMs) fall far short of human performance on physics benchmarks. Reinforcement learning can improve reasoning via reward signals, but it remains unclear whether these signals must come from outside the model or can be derived from the model itself. We compare external rewards, which rely on an outside verifier (rule-based format and answer-correctness checks, or an LLM-judge rubric), with an internal attention-based reward computed from the model's own attention over image regions, requiring no labels or judge. We find that external rewards drive most of the accuracy gains, while preserving more coherent reasoning when rewarded for reasoning tokens. translated_title: 视觉语言模型中物理推理的奖励设计
translated_abstract: 基于图像的物理推理需要整合感知、领域知识和多步符号推理，然而视觉语言模型（VLMs）在物理基准测试中的表现远不及人类。强化学习可以通过奖励信号来改进推理，但这些信号是否必须来自模型外部，还是可以从模型自身中推导得出，目前仍不清楚。我们将依赖外部验证器的外部奖励（包括基于规则的格式与答案正确性检查，或大语言模型评判的评分标准）与基于注意力的内部奖励进行比较，后者由模型自身对图像区域的注意力计算得出，无需标注或评判者。我们发现，外部奖励带来了大部分的准确率提升，并且在奖励推理token时能够保持更连贯的推理过程。而基于注意力的内部奖励则提供了一种无需标注的接地信号，能够改善空间关系推理，并与外部奖励形成互补。
tldr: 本文系统比较了外部奖励与基于模型自身注意力的内部奖励对视觉语言模型物理推理能力的影响，发现外部奖励贡献了主要准确率提升，而内部注意力奖励作为一种无需标注的接地信号可有效改善空间关系推理，二者互补。
en_tdlr: This paper compares external rewards with an internal attention-based reward for physical reasoning in vision-language models, finding that external rewards drive most accuracy gains, while the annotation-free internal attention reward improves spatial-relation reasoning and complements external signals.
